situations.title: 자살 사고 초기 선별
situations.tagline: I just don't see the point in anything anymore.
situations.brief: 콜롬비아 척도 순서로 자살 사고·계획·수단을 단계적으로 확인하고 안전을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself?
Do you have a plan for how you would do it?
I want you to know you're safe here and I'm listening.

situations.title: 소지품·환경 안전 점검
situations.tagline: Why do you need to take my things? I'm not a criminal.
situations.brief: 끈·벨트·약 등 위험 소지품 회수의 이유를 존중하는 태도로 설명하고 협조를 얻으세요.
keyPhrases: For your safety, I need to hold onto a few items for now.
You'll get everything back when you're discharged.
This is something we do for everyone in this room.
goals: 위험 소지품 회수의 목적을 비처벌적으로 전달한다

situations.title: 자발적 정신과 내원 접수
situations.tagline: I finally decided to come in and ask for help.
situations.brief: 자발적으로 내원한 환자의 주호소를 정리하고 용기를 인정하며 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: It took a lot of courage to come here today.
Can you tell me what's been the hardest part lately?
You're in the right place, and we'll take it one step at a time.

situations.title: 공황발작 첫 대응
situations.tagline: My heart is pounding — I think I'm dying.
situations.brief: 신체 응급을 배제하는 동시에 호흡 코칭으로 급성 공황을 가라앉히세요.
keyPhrases: You're safe — this feeling will pass, I'm right here with you.
Let's breathe together, in for four, out for four.
Your heart is working hard, but we're checking everything to be sure.

situations.title: 우울 스크리닝(PHQ) 문진
situations.tagline: Nothing really makes me happy these days.
situations.brief: 무쾌감·수면·식욕 등 PHQ 항목을 자연스러운 대화로 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Over the last two weeks, how has your sleep been?
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
Thank you for being honest with me — that helps a lot.

situations.title: 자살 시도 직후 소통
situations.tagline: I didn't think I'd wake up. Why did you bring me back?
situations.brief: 소생 직후 수치심과 절망을 다루며 비판단적으로 라포를 형성하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm glad you're here — you don't have to explain anything right now.
You're not being judged. I just want to understand how you're feeling.
We'll get through the next steps together, at your pace.
goals: 소생 후 수치심을 자극하지 않고 신뢰를 만든다
이후 정신과 평가로 이어지는 안정감을 준다

situations.title: 자해 반복 청소년
situations.tagline: Please don't tell my mom everything I say.
situations.brief: 부모 동석 상황에서 비밀보장 경계를 설명하고 청소년과 신뢰를 만드세요.
keyPhrases: Some things stay between us, but safety I do have to share.
I hear that you want your own space to talk — that's fair.
You're not in trouble here; we just want to help you feel better.
goals: 비밀보장의 범위와 안전 예외를 명확히 한다

situations.title: 홀딩(비자의 억류) 고지
situations.tagline: You can't keep me here against my will!
situations.brief: 비자의 억류의 법적 근거와 인간적 배려를 함께 담아 고지하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a temporary hold to keep you safe while we assess.
You still have rights, and I'll explain each step to you.
I know this feels unfair — let me walk you through why.

situations.title: 물질 유발 정신증
situations.tagline: They're watching me through the vents — I can hear them.
situations.brief: 편집 사고를 자극하지 않는 언어로 현실 감각과 안전을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: I can see you're scared — you're safe in this room with me.
I don't hear what you hear, but I believe it feels real to you.
Let's keep the door open so you can see everyone around you.
goals: 편집 사고를 자극하지 않고 안전감을 준다

situations.title: 자살 위험 부정 환자
situations.tagline: I already told you I'm fine. Can I just go home?
situations.brief: 축소 진술 뒤 위험 신호를 포착하고 부드럽게 재평가하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear you say you're fine — I just want to double-check a few things.
Sometimes people say they're okay when they're really struggling.
There's no wrong answer here; I only want to keep you safe.
goals: 축소 진술 이면의 위험 신호를 포착한다

situations.title: 정신과 병력+신체 주호소
situations.tagline: Everyone thinks it's just in my head, but my chest really hurts.
situations.brief: 정신과 병력에 가려지지 않도록 진짜 흉통 가능성을 진지하게 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Your chest pain is real to me, and we're going to check it properly.
Having anxiety doesn't mean this can't also be something physical.
Tell me exactly where it hurts and what it feels like.
goals: 정신과 낙인 없이 신체 증상을 사정한다

situations.title: 애도·급성 위기 반응
situations.tagline: My husband died this morning. I don't know what to do.
situations.brief: 급성 애도 반응과 정신과적 위기를 구분하며 정서적 지지를 제공하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm so sorry for your loss — take all the time you need.
There's no right way to feel right now.
I'm here to sit with you and help however I can.

situations.title: 1:1 관찰(sitter) 배정 설명
situations.tagline: Why does someone have to sit and stare at me all night?
situations.brief: 존엄을 지키며 1:1 관찰의 목적을 설명하고 불편을 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: This person is here just to make sure you're safe, not to judge you.
You can talk to them or not — whatever feels comfortable.
It's a temporary support while we work on the next steps.

situations.title: 자살 안전 계획 수립
situations.tagline: What am I supposed to do when it gets bad again?
situations.brief: 대처 전략·연락처·수단 제거를 함께 담은 안전 계획을 협력적으로 세우세요.
keyPhrases: Let's list a few people you can call when things feel dark.
What has helped you get through hard moments before?
We'll make a plan together that you can actually use.
goals: 수단 제거를 포함한 실행 가능한 계획을 만든다

situations.title: 급성 정신증 흥분 상태
situations.tagline: Get away from me — you're all part of it!
situations.brief: 안전 거리를 유지하며 진정과 안전을 동시에 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to keep my distance — I'm not here to hurt you.
You're in control of this conversation; tell me what you need.
Let's lower the noise and lights so you feel more at ease.

situations.title: 강박 억제·비자의 투약
situations.tagline: Let me go! You have no right to drug me!
situations.brief: 억제와 비자의 투약의 사유를 설명하고 최소화·재사정을 약속하세요.
keyPhrases: This is only until you're safe, and we'll reassess constantly.
I'll tell you exactly what medication we're giving and why.
As soon as it's safe, these restraints come off.

situations.title: 자살 시도 후 거부 환자
situations.tagline: I refuse treatment. Just let me sign out.
situations.brief: 능력 평가와 법적 억류의 필요성을 판단하며 존중적으로 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear you want to leave — let me make sure you understand the risks.
Right now my job is to keep you safe, even when it's hard.
Can you tell me what you think will happen if you go home?

situations.title: 정신과 병상 대기(boarding)
situations.tagline: It's been two days in this room. When do I get a real bed?
situations.brief: 장기 체류 환자와 가족의 좌절을 인정하고 현실적 정보를 제공하세요.
keyPhrases: I know this wait has been exhausting for both of you.
Beds are limited, and I'm checking for openings every shift.
Let me tell you exactly what we're doing while you wait.

situations.title: 살인 사고·타해 위협
situations.tagline: When I get out, he's going to pay for what he did.
situations.brief: 타해 위협의 구체성을 사정하고 Tarasoff 고지·다직역 조율을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: It sounds like you're carrying a lot of anger — can we talk about it?
Do you have a specific plan or person in mind?
I have to take threats seriously to keep everyone safe, including you.

situations.title: 긴장증(catatonia) 의심
situations.tagline: 아무 말 없이 한 곳만 응시하며 미동도 없음
situations.brief: 무반응 상태에서 신체적·정신과적 원인을 동시에 감별하며 존중적으로 접근하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to explain everything I do, even if you can't respond.
I'm here with you and you're safe.
I'll check a few things gently to understand what's happening.

situations.title: 이송 중 급속 악화
situations.tagline: I can't wait anymore. I need it to stop right now.
situations.brief: 정신과 이송 대기 중 자해 재발 위험을 즉시 사정하고 안전을 재확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Something's changed — talk to me about what's going on right now.
You're not alone in this hallway; I'm staying right here.
Let's get you somewhere safer while we sort this out.
goals: 대기 중 급속 악화를 신속히 사정한다
